name: changeOrderDecider
description:
Overview

This agent is responsible for processing decisions made on a Change Order. Upon approval, it orchestrates the necessary updates to the associated Project's financial balance, materializes new work or product order line items, and notifies the customer.

Behavior

The agent acts as a transactional orchestrator. When invoked with an approved Change Order, it ensures the Project's balanceDue is accurately recalculated, incorporating the approved changes and taxes while avoiding double-counting deposits. It then translates approved Labor line items into Work Order scope and Product line items into Product Order Line Items under a draft holding order. The customer is automatically notified of the decision. The agent is designed to prevent re-processing of already decided Change Orders, returning an error (409 conflict) if attempted. It specifically does not alter the WorkOrder.total as this is managed separately for installer payments.

Examples

When a ChangeOrder with ID 'CO-456' is marked as 'Approved', the agent is invoked. It updates Project 'P-101's balanceDue, creates relevant ProductOrderLineItems and WorkOrder entries, and sends an email to the customer associated with Project 'P-101'. The agent then returns a success confirmation.

Domain knowledge

Understands the relationships between ChangeOrder, Project, ChangeOrderLineItem, ProductOrder, ProductOrderLineItem, WorkOrder, and Customer. Knows the financial calculation logic for Project.balanceDue and the implications of different ChangeOrder statuses. Aware that WorkOrder.total is distinct from Project.balanceDue.
